sources.author: Work Aiden
sources.limitations: Every actor, timestamp and measurement is invented for a deterministic software demonstration. No retrieval, real sensor or independent corroboration. The first cutoff is an as-of fixture projection, not a historical blind observation.

B-ARRIVAL.assertion: Critical-circuit meter records battery energy reaching the circuit from 09:00.
B-ARRIVAL.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

B-NEED.assertion: At 08:00 the facilities log identifies a possible generator fuel gap after 09:00 and requests the battery bridge. This is a projected need, not an observed outage.
B-NEED.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

B-PLAN.assertion: The invented exercise procedure requires the battery to supply the 10 kW critical circuit during a generator gap.
B-PLAN.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

B-READY.assertion: Fictional acceptance readings show 12 kWh AC-usable stored energy and a 12 kW discharge limit at 08:00.
B-READY.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

B-RUNTIME.assertion: Battery output log records 10 kW for 30 minutes, 09:00–09:30, using 5 kWh AC energy; transfer back to generator completes at 09:30.
B-RUNTIME.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

B-SERVICE.assertion: During 09:00–09:30 the fictional critical-service log records uninterrupted supply on the defined circuit while the generator is stopped.
B-SERVICE.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

B-SWITCH.assertion: Automatic transfer log records battery output beginning at 09:00 when initial generator fuel is exhausted.
B-SWITCH.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

P-ACK.assertion: The dispatch desk acknowledges the order at 08:05; this is an order receipt, not physical fuel delivery.
P-ACK.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

P-CALL.assertion: The primary dispatch desk communicates the stock shortfall to the clinic at 08:16; the clinic records receiving that callback.
P-CALL.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

P-NEED.assertion: At 08:00 the clinic reports 10 L usable fuel and a 10 L/hour generator draw at a 10 kW critical load. Refill is needed.
P-NEED.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

P-NODISPATCH.assertion: Primary dispatch log at 08:15 records no load or vehicle dispatched because usable stock is zero.
P-NODISPATCH.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

P-ORDER.assertion: Primary supplier accepts the 80 L order at 08:05 and commits to delivery by 08:50. A promise does not establish available inventory.
P-ORDER.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

P-STOCK.assertion: At 08:15 the primary supplier inventory check shows zero usable diesel for this order.
P-STOCK.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-ALLOCATION.assertion: A fictional coordination desk announces a nominal 100 L allocation at 07:50. This is not dispatch, available stock or delivery.
R-ALLOCATION.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-COMMIT.assertion: Alternate supplier commits at 08:20 to deliver 80 L by 08:50.
R-COMMIT.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-DISPATCH.assertion: Carrier load/dispatch log records 80 L dispatched at 08:25.
R-DISPATCH.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-LATE.assertion: Receipt time 09:20 is 30 minutes after the explicit 08:50 delivery commitment.
R-LATE.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-MOVEMENT.assertion: Carrier movement log records the loaded vehicle en route at 08:40. Movement does not establish delivery.
R-MOVEMENT.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-NEED.assertion: The clinic requests an alternative after the primary supplier reports its stock shortage.
R-NEED.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-QUANTITY.assertion: The fictional calibrated delivery meter records 80 L actually delivered at 09:20.
R-QUANTITY.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-RECEIPT.assertion: At 09:20 the receiving role signs an 80 L metered delivery receipt and records fuel accepted into the generator tank.
R-RECEIPT.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-RUNTIME.assertion: Generator log records restart at 09:30 and two hours of verified operation through 11:30 at 10 kW; meter records 20 L consumed and 60 L remaining.
R-RUNTIME.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

R-SERVICE.assertion: Fictional service-monitoring log records continuous supply to the defined critical circuit from 08:00 through 11:30, including battery supply during 09:00–09:30 and generator operation thereafter.
R-SERVICE.provenance: Work-authored fictional input. No external receipt, sensor or independent witness.

sources.title: Fictional critical-service resupply receipts and meter logs
